warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).

Widths: where two widths are printed (1.00/0.90, 0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70) the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m). Door heights 2.05 to ระดับพื้นห้อง; windows น1-น3 sill 0.85 + 1.20 = head 2.05, น4 sill 1.60 + 0.55 = 2.15 — every printed sum closes.
Panel counts (panel_note) are counted from the drawn elevations, not printed.
